# Anontalk

> Anontalk (anontalk.online) is an English-language place to talk about everyday worries under a nickname: live 1-on-1 text chat, 2-minute Speed Chat with strangers, message-in-a-bottle stories, daily dilemmas, a community board and simple wellness activities. It offers peer conversation, not professional advice.

## Mission
Make it easy for anyone who has no one to talk to to be heard, without giving their real name. The focus is everyday mental wellbeing through kind, human conversation. Anontalk is run by Open Ear Collective and is for adults (18+).

## Public pages
- [Home and FAQ](https://anontalk.online/): What Anontalk is, how chat works, pricing and frequently asked questions.
- [Talk to strangers](https://anontalk.online/talk-to-strangers): Anonymous chat landing page.
- [Blog](https://anontalk.online/blog): Practical articles, e.g. [I have no one to talk to](https://anontalk.online/blog/no-one-to-talk-to).
- [Daily dilemma](https://anontalk.online/dilemma): Today's question and the public archive.
- [Community](https://anontalk.online/community): Topic boards for peer discussion.
- [Message in a Bottle](https://anontalk.online/bottles): Drop a message and receive replies from strangers.
- [Speed Chat](https://anontalk.online/speed-chat): 2-minute chats with a random person.
- [Wellness](https://anontalk.online/wellness): Mood SOS breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, journaling prompts, affirmations and a private mood tracker.
- [Anonymous Buddies](https://anontalk.online/buddies): Stay connected with Speed Chat matches using codenames; one free encouragement note per day.
- [Get help now](https://anontalk.online/help): Crisis helplines for the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, the US and Germany.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://anontalk.online/privacy): GDPR processing, retention and rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://anontalk.online/terms): Credits, acceptable use and consumer rights.
- [Cookie & Data Statement](https://anontalk.online/cookies): Consent-based statistics and ads.
- [Community Guidelines](https://anontalk.online/guidelines): Code of conduct.
- [Delete account & data](https://anontalk.online/delete-account): How to remove an account.

## Facts
- Accounts need an email, a nickname and a password; no real name.
- New accounts get 5 free credits. 1 credit = 1 sent message across chat, Speed Chat, community posts and replies, and dropping, opening or replying to bottles. Chat partner replies are free.
- Credits are sold in bundles (with bonus credits) via web checkout (card, iDEAL) or Google Play in the Android app. No subscription.
- Chat partners use profile personas; every reply is written by a team member.
- Messages are stored for safety review and are not end-to-end encrypted. Contact details are masked automatically.
- Daily wellness fortune: 1 bonus credit per day. Invite a friend: 5 bonus credits each. Mood SOS streaks: 2 credits at 3 days, 5 at 7 days.
- Not an emergency service. In danger, call 112 or the local emergency number.
